How to apply

Enrolling takes four steps, from choosing your course to arriving in Assisi.

  1. Choose your course

    • In a group: the standard course, 18 lessons a week.
    • In a group, with individual lessons: the intensive course (22 lessons a week) or the super-intensive course (26 lessons a week). See all intensive, super-intensive and thematic courses.
    • One to one, in person: private lessons at the Accademia.
    • One to one, online: online lessons, wherever you are.
    • Language and culture together: our programs combine Italian lessons with a specific aspect of Italian culture.

    Not sure which one fits? Build your course with the configurator or see calendar and fees.

  2. Enroll

    Fill out the enrollment form on the page of the course you chose. In the form you tell us:

    • your preferred payment method;
    • whether you need accommodation: an independent apartment, or a single or double room in a shared apartment;
    • whether you need a student visa.

    If you need a visa, enroll well in advance and read the visa information page first.

  3. Get your confirmation

    Within [X] days we send you:

    • a pro forma invoice. Payment is due before the course begins. We recommend a bank transfer to our Wise account: no fees for transfers in euros. Other payment methods and refund conditions are in the FAQ;
    • the level test, if you are not a beginner: a link to an online test and an appointment for a short online conversation, so we can place you in the right class;
    • your accommodation details, if you asked for it: photos, floor plan, distance from the Accademia and terms;
    • a pre-enrollment certificate, if you need a visa.

  4. Arrive in Assisi

    Your accommodation is available from the day before the course begins. Someone will meet you at the apartment with the keys (€150 cash deposit, returned when you leave). On your first day, we’ll see you at the Accademia at 9:00.

Questions before you enroll?

Book an online orientation meeting via Zoom. Write to info@aliassisi.it or message us on WhatsApp (text only) at +39 351 553 7976.
